name: firefly_generate_image
description: Generate high-fidelity AI images via Adobe Firefly microservice. Supports GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst (default 5 cr), Firefly Image 4 (0 cr FREE), FLUX, Gemini, and Runway.

prompt.description: Detailed text prompt describing the image to generate.

model_id.description: Model ID to use. Default is 'gpt-image-2-5-prism' (5 cr). Free options: 'clio-v4-standard', 'clio-v3-standard'. Others: 'flux-2-pro' (20 cr), 'nano-banana-3' (20 cr), 'runway-gen4' (40 cr).

aspect.description: Aspect ratio. Default is 'auto' (1024x1024). Use '3:4' for vertical posters, '16:9' for horizontal.

quality.description: Quality detail level. Default is 'medium' (5 cr). 'high' costs 15 cr.

reference_images.description: Up to 4 reference image URLs, local file paths, or asset IDs.

reference_usage.description: How to apply reference image (default: 'subject'). 'subject' keeps character identity, 'style' copies art style.
